baseline_sources.deployment_context: Provider post-incident account of an authentication-edge overload affecting live ChatGPT availability and login or signup across ChatGPT, Codex and platform.openai.com.
baseline_sources.evidence_status_basis: OpenAI's directly reviewed incident page and write-up report the provider's own telemetry, root-cause analysis, mitigation and recovery; the evidence status is bounded to that first-party account.
baseline_sources.interpretive_reliance: Controlling source for the occurrence window, affected products, provider-attributed mechanism and remediation. It is not used to infer affected-user counts or consequences beyond the published account.

primary_artefact_access.access_method: direct public review of the canonical OpenAI Status incident page and linked write-up
limitations: The write-up is the provider's retrospective account and does not publish raw telemetry, internal logs or an independently verified user count.

baseline_sources.relevance_note: Establishes that an authentication-edge overload and amplified retry, caching and routing behaviour reduced availability, while backend availability errors unnecessarily triggered login flows.
baseline_sources.source_context: OpenAI reports that from approximately 07:18 to 09:00 PDT some users experienced ChatGPT errors or login and signup failures across ChatGPT, Codex and platform.openai.com. The provider attributes the incident to overload in an internal authentication-edge dependency, amplified by retry, caching and routing behaviour. It states that backend availability errors unnecessarily triggered login flows, substantially recovered availability by 08:40 and fully recovered overall metrics by 09:00.

baseline_sources.relevance_note: Corroborates partial rather than universal impact, including login failures, inaccessible conversations, blank pages and long response times.
baseline_sources.source_context: TechRadar observed that the outage affected users differently: some could not log in, some could not load old conversations, and others saw blank pages or slow responses while some new-chat and Codex access continued. It reported a peak above 8,700 Downdetector reports in the UK and about 1,900 in the US, followed by a rapid decline during provider mitigation.
